question: What is the meaning of use-phase management in relation to life cycle information?
description: Use-phase management in relation to life cycle information involves activities related to the period when a product is actively being utilized. This includes aspects such as maintenance, repair, replacement, operational energy use, operational water use, and other activities that occur during the functional use of a building or product. It focuses on optimizing the performance and efficiency of the product during its operational lifespan.
